references.text: The Lord gives instructions that the land is to be distributed by casting lots, which is the method mentioned in Numbers 34:13
Moses gave land to the tribe of Gad, the tribe of Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, explaining why only nine and a half tribes were to receive land west of the Jordan
Earlier command to distribute the land by casting lots according to the size of the tribes
Joshua was to lead Israel into the inheritance land, which Moses gives instructions about here
The fulfillment of the command in Numbers 34:13, where the nine and a half tribes receive their inheritance by casting lots in the land of Canaan
Joshua carries out the casting of lots to distribute the land, as Moses commanded
David's psalm mentions that the Lord has assigned an inheritance by lot, which relates to the distribution of the land
Paul refers to God assigning areas of land to the people of Israel as an inheritance, a reference to this command
